summary: Boyd Group Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Interim Report to Shareholders for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, including MD&A, interim condensed consolidated financial statements, CEO and CFO certifications dated November 11, 2026, and a same-day press release. No transaction, ownership stake, price, premium or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly reporting package for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly earnings filing, with no deal terms. Watch only operational updates, such as location count of 1,336 collision repair centers and glass operations.
